notes: Piece counts match the parts list per type and colour (444 pieces).

Fixed after checking: b222 and b223 (1x2 plates) now rest on only the two plates under their two studs. b378 and b409 (1x10 plates in the Hancock modules) now rest only on the 3x3 plate b373 or b404, because a grille tile has no studs to hold them.

The booklet pictures are small and several sub-assemblies are drawn from odd angles, so the exact rests_on chains inside the base, the Willis Tower and the Hancock arms and modules are best-effort inferences. The per-type counts are exact, but a few single placements are guesses.
Steps 50-57 build a sub-assembly that is turned upside down. It is recorded in plain stacking order, with the 3x3 plate on the plaza studs and the plates above it.

Some pieces in the parts list could not be matched to a booklet icon one-for-one. In particular, 2 of the 8 Light Bluish Gray 1x2 tiles (3069b) and 2 of the 5 Light Bluish Gray 1x4 tiles (2431) were placed so that the per-step piece counts still add up.
Pieces attached sideways (grilles, 1x4 tiles, slopes and vertical plates on side studs of brackets or bricks) are listed in other_joins with rests_on empty.
The 4 'house' plates, the 2 clips and the 2 bridge leaves are placed by reading the pictures. The 15712 clip tiles hold the dark tan handle plates of the bridge leaves.
Two copies of the Hancock module (steps 100-110) and of the Hancock arm (step 98) are listed in full. Each module's first 3x3 plate is assumed to sit on its own arm's studs.
The whole base is built before the model is rotated at step 30. Step 48 places Big Red on the black 2x2 plate (b87), and step 94 puts the Wrigley tower on the turntable top.
position is null for every piece, as required.
